Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionTaking place over one sweltering summer... Deliver packages Hop on your BMX and deliver letters and packages to the quirky inhabitants of TANUKI’s fictional Japanese island. Packages vary in size, weight, and shape so it'll be up to you to strategise how you approach each delivery. Sushi Chef, Sumo Wrestler, Baseball Pro! As you build up friendship and loyalty with the inhabitants, they'll ask for help with a range of different activities. Take part to unlock items and rewards that will help with the shrine's restoration. The Island Is Your Playground (or Pon'y Hawk!?) Hop on Pon’s BMX and explore the island on two wheels. Launch off ramps, grind along rails, and string together tricks and combos as you discover new paths, radical heights and everything in between. Restore the shrine to former glory You've been tasked with getting the Tanuki Shrine ready for the Great Tanuki Matsuri at the end of summer! Turn your earnings from deliveries, activities and over 100 BMX challenges into a shrine you’re proud of: build, upgrade and make it your own. With the Tanuki Festival just around the corner, Pon must restore the shrine to its former glory. Help him earn cash, befriend the local townsfolk, and prep the shrine for the festival of a lifetime. BMX your way into the hearts of all the townsfolk as a mail delivery Tanuki! You've got one month to save up enough to restore the shrine for the Great Tanuki Festival. Deliver packages, compete in sports, make sushi, and much much more in TANUKI!Show morePublished byCRITICAL REFLEXDeveloped byDenkiworksPlay withXBOX OneXBOX Series X|SPCHandheldCapabilitiesSingle playerOptimized for Xbox Series X|SSmart DeliveryXbox achievementsXbox clubsXbox cloud savesXbox Play AnywhereComing to these subscriptionsPC onlyUltimate XBOX consoles XBOX games XBOX Game Pass XBOX accessories XBOX News XBOX Support Feedback Community Standards Photosensitive Seizure Warning User Research at XBOX Microsoft account Microsoft Store Support Returns Orders tracking Store locations Rewards Games Designed for XBOX English (United States) Your Privacy Choices Opt-Out Icon Your Privacy Choices Consumer Health Privacy Sitemap Contact Microsoft Privacy & Cookies Manage cookies Terms of use Trademarks Third Party Notices Safety & eco About our ads

source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 7Gambling ThemesGamesRACCOIN: Chaos Max EditionReleases 11/10/26VersionNintendo Switch 2EditionDigitalGambling ThemesLoadingRACCOIN is a roguelike deckbuilder where you combine special coins with powerful items to trigger wildly satisfying combos.RACCOIN: Chaos Max Edition blends the chaotic fun of classic arcade coin pushers with the element of roguelike deckbuilding. Combine special coins with powerful items to trigger satisfying synergies. It’s a nonstop dopamine rush packed into one unpredictable, coin dropping ride.SYNERGIZING COINS & CHAOSDiscover all kinds of special coins during your runs! Combine Seed Coins with Water Coins to grow a money tree right inside your machine. Drop a Cat Coin to hunt down every last Rat Coin and rack up extra tickets. Need more points? Use a Multiply Coin to boost your score across the board. Too slow? Launch a Nuclear Coin to trigger a massive explosion and blast every coin forward at once!CRAFT POWERFUL STRATEGIES WITH ITEMSStack multipliers, spawn coins with extra points, or simply shake the machine when you're running dry. Apply special plating to your favorite coins to enhance their effects and unlock even wilder combos.DIFFERENT CHARACTERS, DISTINCT PLAYSTYLESPlay as one of several unique characters, each with their own set of themed coins and playstyle. Take on the role of a greedy raccoon manager who excels at math-based combos, or a quirky biologist who specializes in animal-based coins. Every character offers a fresh and wildly different way to play.Software description provided by the publisher.Related tagsSimulationChoose your difficultyPlay for a high scoreShow moreAbout this itemGame file size (estimated)800 MBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeNo. of playersSingle system (1)Nintendo Account family-group lendingSupportedNintendo Switch OnlineSave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership.
